name: scenario-case-admission
goal: Reject scenario tests without their declared standard cases when the test policy is required.

evidence: Required-policy scenarios can currently execute a check with no declared case references and therefore select no cases for the execution gate.
The existing TestContractService.validate case covers orphaned executed tests but no scenario reference matrix; extend that case without adding a test title.
Red 05ab08f3e8e3 at 6e176d0b9a shows a required scenario without case references was admitted.
Commit 16be09ac2d requires unique, active and state-scoped case references when the policy is enabled.
Green 8ae6a8d28a7d passes the same unchanged registered case and environment.
